history.summary: A 753 sqft 'compact 3BR' at $1.035M in D14 near Paya Lebar MRT interchange (670m). Very low quantum and a strong growth corridor, but the resale-only appreciation is NEGATIVE (-1.68%/yr) on just 17 transactions, signaling either price weakness or a tiny/illiquid sample.
history.rating_rationale: The entry case is appealing: $1.035M is among the cheapest 3BR-tagged units here, D14 has the Paya Lebar Central / airbase-relocation catalyst, and 670m to a EWL/CCL interchange is strong transit. But two flags temper it: (1) resale-only CAGR is -1.68%/yr — negative — on only 17 txns, so prices have not appreciated (or the sample is too thin to trust); and (2) a 753 sqft '3BR' is a squeezed shoebox layout that limits genuine family-buyer appeal. Low quantum + location keep it liquid, but the negative trend rules out Buy.

history.summary: Small 753 sqft unit in a boutique 60-unit Geylang (D14) project asking $1,374 psf, genuinely below the verified ~$1,588 psf recent average — but the '3BR' label on 753 sqft is a real mismatch (effectively a compact 2BR+study), and the Geylang location caps appreciation and exit liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified recent Sixteen35 transactions average ~$1,588 psf (range $1,495-$1,670), so the $1,374 psf ask is a credible ~13% discount, supporting the algo's -32.7% age-adj and -12.0% vs-cohort signals (cohort is moderately deep at 13 txns, so the cheapness is more trustworthy than a thin-cohort quirk). However, 753 sqft for a '3BR' is the flagged bedroom_sqft_mismatch — this is a squeezed layout that will read as a small 2BR to most buyers, hurting both livability and resale. D14 Geylang carries a persistent stigma/red-light-adjacency discount that suppresses forward appreciation despite OCR/RCR-fringe location. Tiny 60-unit project means thin secondary liquidity. The discount is real, but it is partly the market pricing in the layout and location, so I land at Neutral rather than Buy.

Geylang (D14) stigma/red-light adjacency structurally caps appreciation and tenant/buyer pool
catalysts: Paya Lebar / Eunos / Dakota MRT accessibility and proximity to the Paya Lebar commercial cluster
Asking ~13% below verified recent transactions offers an entry-price cushion
